entities.name: Tulan
aliases: Master of the Gray House of Kestha
entities.description: Master of the Gray House of Kestha in Estark, gluttonous and considered the least dangerous House Master.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: Grand Master of Arena who decided to destroy the four Houses.

entities.name: Uriah
entities.description: Captain of Zarel's fighters who sapped Tulan's strength and set him aflame.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: The destruction of the House of Oor-tael, in which Tulan took part.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: The city containing the Gray House of Kestha.

events.summary: Tulan takes part in the Night of Fire, the destruction of the House of Oor-tael.
events.quote: He participated in the Night of Fire

events.summary: Zarel decides to destroy the four Houses; Uriah saps Tulan's strength, Tulan destroys his spell satchel and throws himself off the wall as Uriah sets him aflame.
events.quote: threw himself off the wall of his House

relations.note: Uriah is captain of Zarel's fighters.
relations.quote: Uriah , the captain of Zarel's fighters

relations.note: Zarel decided to destroy the Houses.
relations.quote: decided to destroy the four Houses
